user_intent: Launch a workflow for real external signers
product_insight: Users need a clear path from a draft workflow to full production use, including publish readiness, e-signature legal compliance, monitoring, audit trail, custom domains, and operational checks.

user_intent: Know whether uploaded documents and extracted data are secure
product_insight: Security is a major trust gap, especially for non-technical ops/legal users. Add automated document security review, PII/PHI detection, access-control checks, encryption-at-rest verification, and understandable risk explanations.

user_intent: Get confidence in extraction without understanding the OCR
product_insight: The product should translate extraction confidence into plain language: "high confidence", "needs review", "not ready to publish", with concrete reasons and fixes for low-confidence fields.

user_intent: Move from a manual pilot workflow to full-scale processing without rebuilding
product_insight: Users expect the workflow to remain maintainable as document volume grows. Extraction accuracy and routing-rule maintainability become increasingly important as usage scales.

user_intent: Make last-minute changes to a workflow safely
product_insight: Users need a safe rapid-iteration mode: preview changes against sample documents, regression checks against past automation runs, rollback, change summaries, and warnings when an instruction edit could break existing extraction rules.

user_intent: Iterate a workflow from signer/submitter feedback
product_insight: Support a feedback-to-improvement loop: paste submitter feedback, classify it, identify duplicates, prioritize it, and turn accepted feedback into scoped workflow refinements.

user_intent: Test a workflow without requiring a real signer account
product_insight: Ops teams care about reducing rollout friction. The platform could proactively suggest sandbox mode, seeded sample documents, anonymous test submissions, and shareable preview portals.

user_intent: Add AI extraction for a new document type quickly
product_insight: New document types are becoming expected out of the box. Provide reusable extraction patterns for contracts, invoices, intake forms, purchase orders, structured field extraction, clause detection, and instruction management.

user_intent: Control AI extraction cost and availability at scale
product_insight: Users need cost controls: page-volume quota estimates, budget limits, usage dashboards, model fallbacks, caching of repeated extractions, rate limiting, and alerts before OCR/extraction APIs fail.

user_intent: Understand processing limitations before a high-volume launch
product_insight: Automatically surface scaling risks based on workflow design, such as page-volume limits, concurrent extraction throughput, API quotas, storage limits, and expensive multi-clause extraction rules.

user_intent: Build workflows that pull in location-based or external reference data
product_insight: Address verification, entity/company lookups, geolocation-based routing, and external-data ingestion (registries, sanctions lists) should be first-class patterns rather than something users assemble manually.

user_intent: Get the published portal discoverable and trustworthy for external signers
product_insight: Portal presentation remains a weak point for generated document portals. Provide native custom branding, metadata previews, verified-sender indicators, structured confirmation emails, and portal-health validation.

user_intent: Solve extraction/routing edge cases without understanding the underlying OCR model
product_insight: The system should detect when requested extraction behavior conflicts with the current template/field setup and automatically choose the right field mapping rather than repeatedly editing the wrong rule.

user_intent: Upgrade older workflows built on earlier template versions
product_insight: Long-lived workflows need migrations. Automated template upgrades, extraction-model updates, compatibility checks, and rule modernization become important as the installed base matures.

user_intent: Avoid endless page-credit consumption from repeated extraction corrections
product_insight: Likely frustration around inefficient instruction-writing and repeated correction. Show estimated processing complexity, explain what consumed page credits, reduce unnecessary re-extraction, and reuse previous extraction context.

user_intent: Know whether a requested extraction/routing change actually worked
product_insight: Workflows need automated acceptance testing. After every meaningful change, test extraction accuracy, routing logic, approval steps, signature collection, and delivery on sample documents.

user_intent: Recover when a workflow edit breaks extraction or routing
product_insight: Strong versioning is critical: checkpoints, side-by-side extraction diffs, one-click rollback, branch-like experiments, and "restore last working version."

user_intent: Ask for outcomes, not implementation details, when configuring a workflow
product_insight: The interface should remain intent-driven. The platform should translate "make sure vendors can sign from their phone" into the right mix of mobile-friendly forms, routing, notifications, and publish configuration.

user_intent: Share a workflow early and collect feedback before full rollout
product_insight: Include lightweight public preview portals, feedback widgets, submission replay, annotation, and automatically summarized feedback.
